rows.en:
...What on earth is with this Kazama guy?
This is supposed to be a meeting to hear about the school's seven wonders.
But this way, it's like we're at the rakugo comedy club.
Kazama is looking over at me, grinning away.
What a hopeless guy.
We'd been having such a great time with scary stories up to now, and at the very end, I have to sit through this nonsense...
Ugh, what a miserable day this has been.
Everyone else looks completely deflated, too.
And the seventh one never showed up, no matter how long we waited...
Forget it. I'm done, I'm done.{p}

"Well then, everyone.
Thank you for telling me your scary stories.
It's a shame the seventh person never turned up, but I'd like to put together a feature based on the stories you've told me.
So, let's call it a day here."

Huh?
Who could that be, at this hour?
Don't tell me the seventh one is showing up now...
I hurriedly turned around and looked toward the door.{p}

"Oh, Hino!"
My eyes went wide.
The door had opened, and there was Hino peeking in: Hino, who had set up this meeting and gathered the six of them for me.
"Hey, {a}.
You're working pretty late.
I could still hear people talking in here.
So I figured I'd stop by."
Hino glanced around the room as he said this to me.
He'd said he was too busy to come today, but he must have gotten worried and come by after all.
He's a senior I can really count on.
"Oh, Hino.
Thank you for coming all this way.
In the end one person never came, but we somehow got through the seven wonders meeting.
I'm just about to send everyone home."{p}
Hino listened to me with a puzzled look.

"What are you talking about?
The seven wonders meeting is tomorrow, isn't it?"
"Huh?"
A chill ran down my spine, and I spun around.{p}

The club room was... empty.
"No way! ...This can't be!"
Every last one of the people who had been here a moment ago was gone.
This was the only way in or out.
And yet... they had all vanished like smoke.{p}

"...What's wrong with you? You look like you've seen a ghost.
Weren't you here today getting ready for tomorrow?
Tomorrow's the real thing, after all. Go home early today and get ready for tomorrow."
Hino gave my shoulder a couple of pats.
A voice echoed inside my head.{p}

"See, didn't we tell you?
We're your guardian spirits.
That was fun.
Tomorrow's the real thing.
Give it your best, okay?"
...No way.
...Then they really were my...{p}

"What's gotten into you, shouting all of a sudden?"
"Hino, please!
I can't handle a job this big after all.
Someone... please get someone else to do it tomorrow instead!
I can't take any more of this!"
What kind of face was I making then?
But judging from Hino's expression as he listened to me... I must have looked like I'd seen a real ghost.{p}
Their laughter kept echoing in my head, on and on.{p}
